description: Edited silent screen walkthrough of real local Studio evidence. No UI values were fabricated.

seeded_defect: The initial Rust sum_squares loop deliberately omitted its first input using .skip(1). This is a disclosed demonstration defect, not a naturally observed migration bug.

performance.note: Includes argument conversion and wrapper dispatch; measured on macOS arm64/Python3.14.7. Other cases differ; positive_energy length16 was slower.

limitations: Finite tests do not prove universal equivalence.
